method: Compare the authored illustration with the specific linked movement instructions. Record key mechanics, equipment differences and the resulting changes. This is a source comparison, not an assessment or endorsement by the source author.
appearance: Original shaded human surfaces fitted to the existing movement skeleton. Shaped torso and limbs, hands, shoes, clothing and facial direction cues. No external character, animation or media was copied.

videoPolicy.scope: Use the unmodified provider player only. No downloading, rehosting, extraction or offline video caching. Keep provider controls, attribution and an external watch link. Embedding availability can change.

exercises.name: Bodyweight squat
exercises.geometryChecks: Fixed limb lengths, finite coordinates and non-negative joint heights sampled throughout both sides. Human surfaces and equipment checked against phone framing.

criteria: Keep heels planted.
Let knees follow the direction of the toes.

referenceCheck.changes: Turn the illustrated toes slightly out to agree with the knee direction. Retain the planted feet and controlled squat.
